title: Phase 3: robustness
blurb: Robustness re-runs of the Study 2 conditions across five prompt wordings (p1, n2, n3 and two renamed-letter versions), three runs (greedy plus two fixed-seed runs) and three resolutions (448, 640, 896 px), plus PROCEED-side controls, the new non-YOLO gate G2 and a second model (LFM2-VL-1.6B). Results are aggregated by condition only. The headline operating point is p1 / 640 px / greedy.
